description: A server-side layer built for one client experience that aggregates upstream services and returns exactly what its screens need.
The data shape a screen renders, including derived fields (`initials`) and excluding internal ones (`email`, post `body`).
Starting independent upstream requests together with `Promise.all`/`Promise.allSettled`, so latency is the slowest call instead of the sum.
Degrading secondary data with an explicit flag (`postsUnavailable`) instead of failing the whole response.
Translating upstream outcomes into meaningful client statuses: an upstream 404 stays 404, an upstream crash becomes 502 Bad Gateway.
Generic, shared edge infrastructure (routing, auth, rate limits). Unlike a BFF it holds no per-screen logic.
